query: What is the conversion rate for visitors on the homepage today?
baseline_sql:
```sql
-- Note: nopCommerce doesn't have a built-in visitor tracking table by default.
-- However, we can approximate conversion rate using available data.
-- Conversion Rate = (Orders placed today / Total unique customers who placed orders today) 
-- vs customers who visited (approximated by new customer registrations + existing customers active today)

-- Option 1: Conversion rate based on customers who placed orders today vs all active customers
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.CustomerId) AS customers_who_ordered_today,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.Id) 
        FROM Customer c
        WHERE c.Deleted = 0
          AND c.Active = 1
          AND c.IsSystemAccount = 0
    ) AS total_active_customers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.Id) AS total_orders_today,
    ROUND(
        (COUNT(DISTINCT o.CustomerId) / NULLIF(
            (
                SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c2.Id) 
                FROM Customer c2
                WHERE c2.Deleted = 0
                  AND c2.Active = 1
                  AND c2.IsSystemAccount = 0
            ), 0
        )) * 100, 2
    ) AS conversion_rate_percentage
FROM `Order` o
WHERE o.Deleted = 0
  AND DATE(o.CreatedOnUtc) = CURDATE();

-- Option 2: If using nopCommerce with Log table to track page visits
-- Conversion rate = Orders today / Homepage visits today
SELECT 
    homepage_visits.visit_count AS homepage_visits_today,
    orders_today.order_count AS orders_placed_today,
    ROUND(
        (orders_today.order_count / NULLIF(homepage_visits.visit_count, 0)) * 100, 2
    ) AS conversion_rate_percentage
FROM 
    (
        -- Homepage visits tracked in ActivityLog or Log table
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS visit_count
        FROM ActivityLog al
        INNER JOIN ActivityLogType alt ON al.ActivityLogTypeId = alt.Id
        WHERE alt.SystemKeyword = 'PublicStore.ViewPage'
          AND al.Comment LIKE '%home%'
          AND DATE(al.CreatedOnUtc) = CURDATE()
    ) AS homepage_visits,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.Id) AS order_count
        FROM `Order` o
        WHERE o.Deleted = 0
          AND DATE(o.CreatedOnUtc) = CURDATE()
    ) AS orders_today;

-- Option 3: Session-based conversion using GenericAttribute for last activity
-- Conversion rate = Orders today / Unique visitors today (tracked via last activity date)
SELECT 
    unique_visitors.visitor_count AS unique_visitors_today,
    orders_today.order_count AS orders_placed_today,
    orders_today.unique_customers_ordered AS unique_customers_ordered_today,
    ROUND(
        (orders_today.unique_customers_ordered / NULLIF(unique_visitors.visitor_count, 0)) * 100, 2
    ) AS conversion_rate_percentage
FROM 
    (
        -- Approximate visitors using customers with last activity today
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.Id) AS visitor_count
        FROM Customer c
        WHERE c.Deleted = 0
          AND c.IsSystemAccount = 0
          AND DATE(c.LastActivityDateUtc) = CURDATE()
    ) AS unique_visitors,
    (
        SELECT 
            COUNT(DISTINCT o.Id) AS order_count,
            COUNT(DISTINCT o.CustomerId) AS unique_customers_ordered
        FROM `Order` o
        WHERE o.Deleted = 0
          AND DATE(o.CreatedOnUtc) = CURDATE()
    ) AS orders_today;

-- Option 4: Most practical - Daily conversion summary with order funnel
SELECT 
    CURDATE() AS report_date,
    active_customers.total_active AS total_active_customers,
    active_today.active_today_count AS customers_active_today,
    ordered_today.ordered_count AS customers_ordered_today,
    ordered_today.total_orders AS total_orders_today,
    ROUND(
        (ordered_today.ordered_count / NULLIF(active_today.active_today_count, 0)) * 100, 2
    ) AS daily_conversion_rate_pct,
    ROUND(
        (ordered_today.ordered_count / NULLIF(active_customers.total_active, 0)) * 100, 4
    ) AS overall_conversion_rate_pct
FROM
    (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Id) AS total_active
        FROM Customer
        WHERE Deleted = 0 AND Active = 1 AND IsSystemAccount = 0
    ) AS active_customers,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Id) AS active_today_count
        FROM Customer
        WHERE Deleted = 0
          AND IsSystemAccount = 0
          AND DATE(LastActivityDateUtc) = CURDATE()
    ) AS active_today,
    (
        SELECT 
            COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerId) AS ordered_count,
            COUNT(Id) AS total_orders
        FROM `Order`
        WHERE Deleted = 0
          AND DATE(CreatedOnUtc) = CURDATE()
    ) AS ordered_today;
```

```sql
    c.Name AS CategoryName,
    c.ParentCategoryId,

        AND parent.Deleted = 0
    INNER JOIN Product_Category_Mapping pcm ON c.Id = pcm.CategoryId
    INNER JOIN Product p ON pcm.ProductId = p.Id
        AND p.Deleted = 0
        AND p.Published = 1
    INNER JOIN OrderItem oi ON p.Id = oi.ProductId
    INNER JOIN `Order` o ON oi.OrderId = o.Id
WHERE 
    c.Deleted = 0
    AND c.Published = 1
    AND o.Deleted = 0
    AND o.OrderStatusId NOT IN (40)
    AND o.PaymentStatusId = 30  -- Paid orders only (30 = Paid)
    AND o.CreatedOnUtc >= DATE_FORMAT(
            DATE_SUB(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), 
                INTERVAL (MONTH(UTC_TIMESTAMP()) - 1 - ((QUARTER(UTC_TIMESTAMP()) - 1) * 3)) MONTH
            ), 
            '%Y-%m-01'
        )
    AND o.CreatedOnUtc < DATE_FORMAT(
            DATE_SUB(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), 
                INTERVAL (MONTH(UTC_TIMESTAMP()) - 1 - ((QUARTER(UTC_TIMESTAMP()) - 1) * 3)) MONTH
            ),
```

```sql
-- Simplified and robust version using explicit quarter start calculation
WITH QuarterBounds AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE(CONCAT(
            YEAR(UTC_TIMESTAMP()), '-',
            LPAD(((QUARTER(UTC_TIMESTAMP()) - 1) * 3) + 1, 2, '0'), '-01'
        )) AS QuarterStart,
        DATE(CONCAT(
            YEAR(UTC_TIMESTAMP()), '-',
            LPAD(((QUARTER(UTC_TIMESTAMP()) - 1) * 3) + 1, 2, '0'), '-01'
        )) + INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS QuarterEnd
),
CategorySales AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Id AS CategoryId,
        c.Name AS CategoryName,
        COUNT(oi.Id) AS TotalLineItems,
        SUM(oi.Quantity) AS TotalUnitsSold,
        ROUND(SUM(oi.PriceExclTax), 2) AS TotalRevenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.Id) AS TotalOrders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.CustomerId) AS UniqueCustomers,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY SUM(oi.Quantity) DESC, COUNT(oi.Id) DESC
        ) AS SalesRank
    FROM 
        Category c
        INNER JOIN Product_Category_Mapping pcm ON c.Id = pcm.CategoryId
        INNER JOIN Product p ON pcm.ProductId = p.Id
            AND p.Deleted = 0
        INNER JOIN OrderItem oi ON p.Id = oi.ProductId
        INNER JOIN `Order` o ON oi.OrderId = o.Id
        CROSS JOIN QuarterBounds qb
    WHERE 
        c.Deleted = 0
        AND c.Published = 1
        AND o.Deleted = 0
        AND o.OrderStatusId NOT IN (40)
        AND o.CreatedOnUtc >= qb.QuarterStart
        AND o.CreatedOnUtc < qb.QuarterEnd
    GROUP BY 
        c.Id,
        c.Name
)
SELECT 
    SalesRank AS `Rank`,
    CategoryId,
    CategoryName,
    TotalLineItems,
    TotalUnitsSold,
    TotalRevenue,
    TotalOrders,
    UniqueCustomers
FROM 
    CategorySales
WHERE 
    SalesRank <= 7
ORDER BY 
    SalesRank;
```

query: Which 10 products have the highest profit margin this month?
baseline_sql:
```sql
SELECT 
    p.Id AS ProductId,
    p.Name AS ProductName,
    p.Sku,
    p.Price AS CurrentPrice,
    p.ProductCost,
    ROUND(AVG(oi.UnitPriceExclTax), 2) AS AvgSellingPrice,
    ROUND(AVG(oi.UnitPriceExclTax) - COALESCE(p.ProductCost, 0), 2) AS AvgProfitPerUnit,
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(p.ProductCost, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ROUND(
            ((AVG(oi.UnitPriceExclTax) - COALESCE(p.ProductCost, 0)) / COALESCE(p.ProductCost, 0)) * 100, 
            2
        )
    END AS ProfitMarginPercentage,
    SUM(oi.Quantity) AS TotalUnitsSold,
    ROUND(SUM(oi.PriceExclTax), 2) AS TotalRevenue,
    ROUND(SUM(oi.Quantity * COALESCE(p.ProductCost, 0)), 2) AS TotalCost,
    ROUND(SUM(oi.PriceExclTax) - SUM(oi.Quantity * COALESCE(p.ProductCost, 0)), 2) AS TotalProfit
FROM 
    Product p
INNER JOIN 
    OrderItem oi ON oi.ProductId = p.Id
INNER JOIN 
    `Order` o ON o.Id = oi.OrderId
WHERE 
    o.OrderStatusId NOT IN (40)  -- Exclude cancelled orders (40 = Cancelled)
    AND o.PaymentStatusId = 30   -- Only paid orders (30 = Paid)
    AND YEAR(o.CreatedOnUtc) = YEAR(UTC_TIMESTAMP())
    AND MONTH(o.CreatedOnUtc) = MONTH(UTC_TIMESTAMP())
    AND p.Deleted = 0
    AND p.ProductCost > 0        -- Only include products with a known cost
GROUP BY 
    p.Id,
    p.Name,
    p.Sku,
    p.Price,
    p.ProductCost
HAVING 
    AVG(oi.UnitPriceExclTax) > 0
ORDER BY 
    ProfitMarginPercentage DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
aegis_message: Profit Margin is measured per order, and grouping by Product Name splits each order across its line items. query: How have cart abandonment rates changed week over week this year?
baseline_sql:

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE weeks AS (
    SELECT
        1 AS week_number,
        DATE_SUB(
            DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL DAYOFYEAR(CURDATE()) - 1 DAY),
            INTERVAL 0 DAY
        ) AS week_start,
        DATE_ADD(
            DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL DAYOFYEAR(CURDATE()) - 1 DAY),
            INTERVAL 6 DAY
        ) AS week_end
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        week_number + 1,
        DATE_ADD(week_start, INTERVAL 7 DAY),
        DATE_ADD(week_end, INTERVAL 7 DAY)
    FROM weeks
    WHERE DATE_ADD(week_start, INTERVAL 7 DAY) <= CURDATE()
),
shopping_cart_sessions AS (
    -- Sessions where items were added to cart (using ShoppingCartItem as proxy for cart sessions)
    -- Group by customer and the week they added items to cart
    SELECT
        YEAR(sci.CreatedOnUtc) AS cart_year,
        WEEK(sci.CreatedOnUtc, 3) AS cart_week,
        MIN(DATE(sci.CreatedOnUtc)) AS week_start_date,
        sci.CustomerId,
        MIN(sci.CreatedOnUtc) AS first_cart_activity,
        MAX(sci.CreatedOnUtc) AS last_cart_activity
    FROM ShoppingCartItem sci
    WHERE
        sci.ShoppingCartTypeId = 1  -- 1 = ShoppingCart (not wishlist)
        AND YEAR(sci.CreatedOnUtc) = YEAR(CURDATE())
    GROUP BY
        YEAR(sci.CreatedOnUtc),
        WEEK(sci.CreatedOnUtc, 3),
        sci.CustomerId
),
cart_sessions_with_orders AS (
    SELECT
        scs.cart_year,
        scs.cart_week,
        scs.week_start_date,
        scs.CustomerId,
        scs.first_cart_activity,
        scs.last_cart_activity,
        -- Check if customer placed an order within 7 days of adding to cart
        CASE
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM `Order` o
                WHERE
                    o.CustomerId = scs.CustomerId
                    AND o.CreatedOnUtc >= scs.first_cart_activity
                    AND o.CreatedOnUtc <= DATE_ADD(scs.last_cart_activity, INTERVAL 7 DAY)
                    AND o.Deleted = 0
            ) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS converted_to_order
    FROM shopping_cart_sessions scs
),
weekly_cart_stats AS (
    SELECT
        cart_year,
        cart_week,
        MIN(week_start_date) AS week_start_date,
        COUNT(*) AS total_cart_sessions,
        SUM(converted_to_order) AS converted_sessions,
        COUNT(*) - SUM(converted_to_order) AS abandoned_sessions,
        ROUND(
            (COUNT(*) - SUM(converted_to_order)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
            2
        ) AS abandonment_rate_pct,
        ROUND(
            SUM(converted_to_order) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
            2
        ) AS conversion_rate_pct
    FROM cart_sessions_with_orders
    GROUP BY
        cart_year,
        cart_week
),
weekly_orders_only AS (
    -- Also capture orders placed this year for additional context
    SELECT
        YEAR(o.CreatedOnUtc) AS order_year,
        WEEK(o.CreatedOnUtc, 3) AS order_week,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.Id) AS total_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.CustomerId) AS ordering_customers
    FROM `Order` o
    WHERE
        YEAR(o.CreatedOnUtc) = YEAR(CURDATE())
        AND o.Deleted = 0
    GROUP BY
        YEAR(o.CreatedOnUtc),
        WEEK(o.CreatedOnUtc, 3)
),

        wcs.cart_year,
        wcs.cart_week,

        wcs.converted_sessions,
        wcs.abandoned_sessions,
        wcs.abandonment_rate_pct,
        wcs.conversion_rate_pct,
        COALESCE(wo.total_orders, 0) AS total_orders_placed,
        COALESCE(wo.ordering_customers, 0) AS ordering_customers,
        -- Week over week change in abandonment rate

            ORDER BY wcs.cart_year, wcs.cart_week
        ) AS abandonment_rate_change_pct_points,
        -- Week over week change in total cart sessions
        LAG(wcs.total_cart_sessions) OVER (
            ORDER BY wcs.cart_year, wcs.cart_week
        ) AS prev_week_cart_sessions,
        wcs.total_cart_sessions - LAG(wcs.total_cart_sessions) OVER (
            ORDER BY wcs.cart_year, wcs.cart_week
        ) AS cart_sessions_change,
        -- Week over week change in abandoned sessions

            ORDER BY wcs.cart_year, wcs.cart_week
        ) AS prev_week_abandoned_sessions,
        wcs.abandoned_sessions - LAG(wcs.abandoned_sessions) OVER (
```

```sql
    ROUND(mgp.gross_profit, 2) AS monthly_gross_profit,
    mgp.gross_profit_margin_pct AS gross_profit_margin_pct,
    mgp.total_units_sold AS units_sold,
    ROUND(mgp.cumulative_gross_profit, 2) AS cumulative_gross_profit,
    ROUND(mgp.prev_month_gross_profit, 2) AS prev_month_gross_profit,
    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN mgp.prev_month_gross_profit IS NOT NULL
                 AND mgp.prev_month_gross_profit <> 0
            THEN ((mgp.gross_profit - mgp.prev_month_gross_profit) / ABS(mgp.prev_month_gross_profit)) * 100
            ELSE NULL
        END, 2
    ) AS month_over_month_growth_pct,
    -- Rank manufacturers by gross profit within each month
    RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY mgp.sale_month
        ORDER BY mgp.gross_profit DESC
    ) AS monthly_gross_profit_rank
FROM
    monthly_gross_profit mgp
ORDER BY
    mgp.sale_year ASC,
    mgp.sale_month_num ASC,
    mgp.revenue_rank ASC;
```

query: Compare the cart abandonment rate before and after the site redesign.
baseline_sql:
```sql
-- Note: nopCommerce doesn't have a direct "cart abandonment" table,
-- but we can derive it from ShoppingCartItem (active carts) vs Orders (completed purchases)
-- The site redesign date needs to be configured below

SET @redesign_date = '2023-06-01'; -- Configure your actual redesign date here

WITH customer_sessions AS (
    -- Customers who added items to cart (before redesign)
    SELECT 
        'Before Redesign' AS period,
        sci.CustomerId,
        MIN(sci.CreatedOnUtc) AS cart_created_date,
        SUM(sci.Quantity * sci.Quantity) AS items_in_cart, -- proxy for cart activity
        MAX(sci.UpdatedOnUtc) AS last_cart_activity
    FROM ShoppingCartItem sci
    WHERE sci.ShoppingCartTypeId = 1 -- 1 = ShoppingCart (not wishlist)
      AND sci.CreatedOnUtc < @redesign_date
    GROUP BY sci.CustomerId

    UNION ALL

    -- Customers who added items to cart (after redesign)
    SELECT 
        'After Redesign' AS period,
        sci.CustomerId,
        MIN(sci.CreatedOnUtc) AS cart_created_date,
        SUM(sci.Quantity * sci.Quantity) AS items_in_cart,
        MAX(sci.UpdatedOnUtc) AS last_cart_activity
    FROM ShoppingCartItem sci
    WHERE sci.ShoppingCartTypeId = 1
      AND sci.CreatedOnUtc >= @redesign_date
    GROUP BY sci.CustomerId
),

orders_placed AS (
    -- Customers who completed an order (before redesign)
    SELECT 
        'Before Redesign' AS period,
        o.CustomerId,
        MIN(o.CreatedOnUtc) AS order_date
    FROM `Order` o
    WHERE o.Deleted = 0
      AND o.CreatedOnUtc < @redesign_date
      AND o.OrderStatusId NOT IN (40) -- exclude cancelled orders (40 = Cancelled)
    GROUP BY o.CustomerId

    UNION ALL

    -- Customers who completed an order (after redesign)
    SELECT 
        'After Redesign' AS period,
        o.CustomerId,
        MIN(o.CreatedOnUtc) AS order_date
    FROM `Order` o
    WHERE o.Deleted = 0
      AND o.CreatedOnUtc >= @redesign_date
      AND o.OrderStatusId NOT IN (40)
    GROUP BY o.CustomerId
),

abandonment_analysis AS (
    SELECT 
        cs.period,
        cs.CustomerId,
        cs.cart_created_date,
        cs.last_cart_activity,
        CASE 
            WHEN op.CustomerId IS NOT NULL THEN 'Converted'
            ELSE 'Abandoned'
        END AS cart_status
    FROM customer_sessions cs
    LEFT JOIN orders_placed op 
        ON cs.CustomerId = op.CustomerId 
        AND cs.period = op.period
        AND op.order_date >= cs.cart_created_date
),

period_summary AS (
    SELECT 
        period,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerId) AS total_customers_with_cart,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cart_status = 'Abandoned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abandoned_carts,
        SUM(CASE WHEN cart_status = 'Converted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS converted_carts,
        ROUND(
            SUM(CASE WHEN cart_status = 'Abandoned' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / 
            NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerId), 0), 
            2
        ) AS abandonment_rate_pct,
        ROUND(
            SUM(CASE WHEN cart_status = 'Converted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / 
            NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerId), 0), 
            2
        ) AS conversion_rate_pct
    FROM abandonment_analysis
    GROUP BY period
),

-- Also calculate using order-level data for more granular view
order_level_analysis AS (
    SELECT
        CASE 
            WHEN o.CreatedOnUtc < @redesign_date THEN 'Before Redesign'
            ELSE 'After Redesign'
        END AS period,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.Id) AS total_orders,
        SUM(CASE WHEN o.OrderStatusId = 40 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled_orders,
        AVG(o.OrderTotal) AS avg_order_value,
        COUNT(DISTINCT o.CustomerId) AS unique_customers_ordered
    FROM `Order` o
    WHERE o.Deleted = 0
    GROUP BY 
        CASE 
            WHEN o.CreatedOnUtc < @redesign_date THEN 'Before Redesign'
            ELSE 'After Redesign'
        END
)

-- Final comparison report
SELECT 
    ps.period,
    ps.total_customers_with_cart,
    ps.abandoned_carts,
    ps.converted_carts,
    ps.abandonment_rate_pct,
    ps.conversion_rate_pct,
    ola.total_orders,
    ola.cancelled_orders,
    ROUND(ola.avg_order_value, 2) AS avg_order_value,
    ola.unique_customers_ordered,
    -- Calculate improvement/decline after redesign
    CASE 
        WHEN ps.period = 'After Redesign' THEN
            ROUND(
                ps.abandonment_rate_pct - (
                    SELECT abandonment_rate_pct 
                    FROM period_summary 
                    WHERE period = 'Before Redesign'
                ), 2
            )
        ELSE NULL
    END AS abandonment_rate_change_pct_points,
    CASE 
        WHEN ps.period = 'After Redesign' THEN
            CASE 
                WHEN ps.abandonment_rate_pct < (
                    SELECT abandonment_rate_pct 
                    FROM period_summary 
                    WHERE period = 'Before Redesign'
                ) THEN 'IMPROVED - Lower Abandonment'
                WHEN ps.abandonment_rate_pct > (
                    SELECT abandonment_rate_pct 
                    FROM period_summary 
                    WHERE period = 'Before Redesign'
                ) THEN 'DECLINED - Higher Abandonment'
                ELSE 'NO CHANGE'
            END
        ELSE 'BASELINE'
    END AS redesign_impact
FROM period_summary ps
LEFT JOIN order_level_analysis ola ON ps.period = ola.period
ORDER BY 
    CASE ps.period 
        WHEN 'Before Redesign' THEN 1 
        WHEN 'After Redesign' THEN 2 
    END;
```

```sql
qualifying_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.Id AS order_id,
        o.OrderStatus,
        o.PaymentStatus,
        o.CreatedOnUtc
    FROM `Order` o
    CROSS JOIN last_quarter lq
    WHERE
        o.CreatedOnUtc >= lq.quarter_start
        AND o.CreatedOnUtc <= DATE_ADD(lq.quarter_end, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
        AND o.Deleted = 0
        AND o.OrderStatusId NOT IN (40) -- exclude cancelled orders (40 = Cancelled)
),

-- Get returned/refunded orders
returned_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.Id AS order_id
    FROM `Order` o
    CROSS JOIN last_quarter lq
    WHERE
        o.CreatedOnUtc >= lq.quarter_start
        AND o.CreatedOnUtc <= DATE_ADD(lq.quarter_end, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
        AND o.Deleted = 0
        AND (
            o.PaymentStatusId = 30  -- Refunded
            OR o.OrderStatusId = 40 -- Cancelled
        )
),

-- Aggregate order items with product and category info
order_item_details AS (
    SELECT
        oi.OrderId,
        oi.ProductId,
        oi.Quantity,
        oi.UnitPriceInclTax,
        oi.UnitPriceExclTax,
        oi.PriceInclTax,
        oi.PriceExclTax,
        p.Name AS product_name,
        p.ProductCost,

        COALESCE(c.Id, 0) AS category_id
    FROM OrderItem oi
    INNER JOIN qualifying_orders qo ON oi.OrderId = qo.order_id
    INNER JOIN Product p ON oi.ProductId = p.Id AND p.Deleted = 0
    LEFT JOIN Product_Category_Mapping pcm ON p.Id = pcm.ProductId
    LEFT JOIN Category c ON pcm.CategoryId = c.Id
        AND c.Deleted = 0
        AND c.ParentCategoryId = 0  -- top-level categories as departments
),

-- Handle products mapped to multiple categories (take first mapping)
order_item_deduped AS (
    SELECT
        oid.*,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY oid.OrderId, oid.ProductId
            ORDER BY oid.category_id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM order_item_details oid
),

order_item_financials AS (
    SELECT
        department_name,
        category_id,
        OrderId,
        ProductId,
        Quantity,
        PriceExclTax AS revenue,
        (PriceExclTax - (COALESCE(ProductCost, 0) * Quantity)) AS gross_profit
    FROM order_item_deduped
    WHERE rn = 1
),

dept_order_counts AS (
    SELECT
        oif.department_name,
        oif.category_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT oif.OrderId) AS total_orders
    FROM order_item_financials oif
    GROUP BY oif.department_name, oif.category_id
),

-- Count returned orders per department
dept_return_counts AS (
    SELECT
        oif.department_name,
        oif.category_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT oif.OrderId) AS returned_orders
    FROM order_item_financials oif
    INNER JOIN returned_orders ro ON oif.OrderId = ro.order_id

),

dept_summary AS (
    SELECT
        oif.department_name,
        oif.category_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT oif.OrderId)                         AS total_orders,
        COUNT(DISTINCT oif.ProductId)                       AS unique_products_sold,
        SUM(oif.Quantity)                                   AS total_units_sold,
        ROUND(SUM(oif.revenue), 2)                          AS total_revenue,
        ROUND(SUM(oif.gross_profit), 2)                     AS total_gross_profit,
        ROUND(AVG(oif.revenue / NULLIF(oif.Quantity, 0)), 2) AS avg_unit_price
    FROM order_item_financials oif
    GROUP BY oif.department_name, oif.category_id
)

    ds.department_name                                              AS Department,
    ds.total_orders                                                 AS `Total Orders`,
    ds.unique_products_sold                                         AS `Unique Products`,
    ds.total_units_sold                                             AS `Units Sold`,
    CONCAT('$', FORMAT(ds.total_revenue, 2))                        AS `Total Revenue`,
    CONCAT('$', FORMAT(ds.total_gross_profit, 2))                   AS `Gross Profit`,
    CONCAT(
        ROUND(

    CONCAT('$', FORMAT(ds.avg_unit_price, 2))                       AS `Avg Unit Price`,
```

```sql
    COALESCE(ROUND(nm.new_total_revenue, 2), 0.00)                          AS `New: Total Revenue`,
```

```sql
        CategoryName,
        SUM(TotalRevenue) AS OverallRevenue
    FROM
        CategoryRevenue
    GROUP BY
        CategoryId,
        CategoryName
    ORDER BY
        OverallRevenue DESC
    LIMIT 5
),

MonthlySnapshot AS (
    SELECT
        cr.CategoryId,
        cr.CategoryName,
        cr.YearMonth,
        cr.TotalRevenue,
        cr.TotalUnitsSold,
        cr.TotalDiscountAmount,
        cr.DiscountedOrderItems,
        cr.TotalOrderItems,
        ROUND(
            (cr.DiscountedOrderItems / NULLIF(cr.TotalOrderItems, 0)) * 100, 2
        ) AS DiscountUsageRate,
        ROUND(
            (cr.TotalDiscountAmount / NULLIF(cr.TotalRevenue + cr.TotalDiscountAmount, 0)) * 100, 2
        ) AS DiscountPercentageOfGross,
        ROUND(cr.TotalRevenue / NULLIF(cr.TotalUnitsSold, 0), 2) AS AvgRevenuePerUnit,
        t5.OverallRevenue AS CategoryOverallRevenue
    FROM
        CategoryRevenue cr
        INNER JOIN Top5Categories t5 ON cr.CategoryId = t5.CategoryId
),

RankedCategories AS (
    SELECT
        t5.CategoryId,
        t5.CategoryName,
        t5.OverallRevenue,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t5.OverallRevenue DESC) AS CategoryRank
    FROM
        Top5Categories t5
```

```sql
WITH promotion_stats AS (
    SELECT
        d.Id AS DiscountId,
        d.Name AS PromotionName,
        d.DiscountTypeId,

        d.DiscountPercentage,
        d.UsePercentage,

        d.StartDateUtc,

        SUM(oi.OriginalProductCost * oi.Quantity) AS TotalCOGS,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN d.UsePercentage = 1
                    THEN (oi.UnitPriceExclTax * d.DiscountPercentage / 100) * oi.Quantity
                ELSE d.DiscountAmount * oi.Quantity
            END
        ) AS EstimatedDiscountGiven,
        SUM(oi.PriceExclTax - (oi.OriginalProductCost * oi.Quantity)) AS GrossProfit
    FROM
        Discount d
        INNER JOIN Discount_AppliedToOrders dao ON d.Id = dao.Discount_Id
        INNER JOIN `Order` o ON dao.Order_Id = o.Id
        INNER JOIN OrderItem oi ON o.Id = oi.OrderId
    WHERE
        o.CreatedOnUtc >= DATE_SUB(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 6 WEEK)
        AND o.Deleted = 0
        AND o.OrderStatusId NOT IN (40)  -- Exclude cancelled orders
        AND d.Deleted = 0
    GROUP BY
        d.Id,
        d.Name,
        d.DiscountTypeId,
        d.DiscountAmount,
        d.DiscountPercentage,
        d.UsePercentage,
        d.RequiresCouponCode,
        d.CouponCode,
        d.StartDateUtc,
        d.EndDateUtc
),
promotion_roi AS (
    SELECT
        ps.*,
        CASE ps.DiscountTypeId
            WHEN 1 THEN 'Assigned to Order Total'
            WHEN 2 THEN 'Assigned to Products'
            WHEN 3 THEN 'Assigned to Categories'
            WHEN 4 THEN 'Assigned to Manufacturers'
            WHEN 5 THEN 'Assigned to Shipping'
            WHEN 6 THEN 'Assigned to Order SubTotal'
            ELSE 'Unknown'
        END AS DiscountTypeName,
        -- Net Profit = Gross Profit - Discount Given
        (ps.GrossProfit - ps.EstimatedDiscountGiven) AS NetProfit,
        -- ROI = (Net Profit / Discount Cost) * 100
        CASE
            WHEN ps.EstimatedDiscountGiven > 0
                THEN ROUND(
                    ((ps.GrossProfit - ps.EstimatedDiscountGiven) / ps.EstimatedDiscountGiven) * 100,
                    2
                )
            ELSE NULL
        END AS ROI_Percentage,
        -- Revenue lift per discount dollar spent
        CASE
            WHEN ps.EstimatedDiscountGiven > 0
                THEN ROUND(ps.TotalRevenue / ps.EstimatedDiscountGiven, 4)
            ELSE NULL
        END AS RevenueLiftRatio,
        -- Average order value for this promotion
        CASE
            WHEN ps.TotalOrders > 0
                THEN ROUND(ps.TotalRevenue / ps.TotalOrders, 2)
            ELSE 0
        END AS AvgOrderValue,
        -- Gross margin percentage
        CASE
            WHEN ps.TotalRevenue > 0
                THEN ROUND((ps.GrossProfit / ps.TotalRevenue) * 100, 2)
            ELSE 0
        END AS GrossMarginPct
    FROM
        promotion_stats ps
    WHERE
        ps.EstimatedDiscountGiven > 0
        AND ps.TotalRevenue > 0
)
```
